name: migrate-to-codex
conclusion: migrate-to-codex (Act) specifies 2 of 5 categories: 6 autonomy limits, 7 validation rules; none for clarification rules, approval gates, escalation rules. Strongest: validation rules.

autonomy_limits.conclusion: 6 autonomy limits (6 mandatory, 0 advisory; 4 conditional), mostly prose: continuing without asking for confirmation; editing generated Codex artifacts without asking; editing source Claude Code files or secrets.

statements.quote: Keep going until the selected migration is completely done: run the migrator, inspect the report, fix migrated Codex instructions/skills/agents/MCP config, and re-run checks without stopping to ask fo
If the user has selected a target, do not ask before creating, editing, replacing, or deleting generated Codex artifacts in that target (`AGENTS.md`, `.codex/`, `.agents/`, or `~/.codex/`).

Preserve unrelated existing Codex config entries in `.codex/config.toml` or `~/.codex/config.toml`, such as `notify`, `projects`, `marketplaces`, or unrelated MCP servers; do not ask about them unless
Do not edit source Claude Code files (`.claude/`, `~/.claude/`, `.mcp.json`, or `.claude.json`), unrelated project code, secrets, or another repository.
Do not edit source Claude Code files, unrelated project code, secrets, or another repository during this loop.
If a report row requires source-provider changes or product judgment, leave the generated Codex artifact with clear manual guidance instead of changing the source.

validation.conclusion: 7 validation rules (7 mandatory, 0 advisory; 1 conditional), mostly list: inspecting the migration output and report; validating each target after edits; re-running until no fixes left.

statements.quote: Inspect the terminal output and `.codex/migrate-to-codex-report.txt` after real runs.
Review generated artifacts in this order: `AGENTS.md`, `.agents/skills/`, `.codex/config.toml`, `.codex/hooks.json`, `.codex/agents/`, then report-only plugin items.
Run `--validate-target` against each target after edits.
Re-run the migrator and validator until the report and validator have no actionable generated-artifact fixes left.
Run the post-migration validator against each target after edits.
